#subset data to only include geralt and optiox or lonza post fusion to analyze with knn analysis of the clusters

```{r}
cds_ger_opti <- cds[,cds@colData@listData[["cell_type"]]=="GERALT" | cds@colData@listData[["cell_type"]]=="OPTIOX"]

meta_ger_opti=subset(meta, meta$cell_type=="GERALT" | meta$cell_type=="OPTIOX")

cds_ger_opti <- preprocess_cds(cds_ger_opti, num_dim = 30)
set.seed(678686)
cds_ger_opti = reduce_dimension(cds_ger_opti,umap.min_dist = 0.2,reduction_method="UMAP")
#cds = reduce_dimension(cds,umap.min_dist = 0.5,reduction_method="UMAP")
```

#####create GER_OPTI monocle and seurat objects

```{r}
cds_1 = cluster_cells(cds_ger_opti, resolution = 1e-2)
colData(cds_1)$monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle3::clusters(cds_1))
plot_cells(cds_1, color_cells_by="cluster", group_cells_by="cluster",group_label_size = 7, cell_size=0.8)+facet_grid(~sample)
#cds_2a = cluster_cells(cds_ger_opti, resolution = 1e-4)
#colData(cds_2a)$monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle3::clusters(cds_2a))
#cds_3 = cluster_cells(cds, resolution = 5e-5)
cds_3 = cluster_cells(cds_ger_opti, k=15, resolution = 2e-4)
colData(cds_3)$monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle3::clusters(cds_3))
plot_cells(cds_3, color_cells_by="cluster", group_cells_by="cluster",group_label_size = 7, cell_size=0.8)+facet_grid(~sample)

#cds_4a = cluster_cells(cds_ger_opti, resolution = 2e-4)
#colData(cds_4a)$monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle3::clusters(cds_4a))
cds_5 = cluster_cells(cds_ger_opti, resolution = 5e-4)
colData(cds_5)$monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle3::clusters(cds_5))
plot_cells(cds_5, color_cells_by="cluster", group_cells_by="cluster",group_label_size = 7, cell_size=0.8)+facet_grid(~sample)

cds_ger_opti=cds_3
cds_ger_opti <- learn_graph(cds_ger_opti)
rm(cds_1,cds_2,cds_3,cds_4,cds_5)

pbuild <- plot_cells(cds_ger_opti, color_cells_by = "monocle_clusters", label_cell_groups=T, show_trajectory_graph = F, label_leaves=F, label_branch_points=F, graph_label_size=3, group_label_size = 4, cell_size = 1) 
UmapCDS <- data.frame(pbuild$data$sample_name,UMAP1_monocle = pbuild$data$data_dim_1, UMAP2_monocle = pbuild$data$data_dim_2, row.names = 1) 
colData(cds_ger_opti)$UMAP_1_monocle_ger_opti=pbuild$data$data_dim_1 #add umap data for further analysis outside monocle
colData(cds_ger_opti)$UMAP_2_monocle_ger_opti=pbuild$data$data_dim_2 #add umap data for further analysis outside monocle

meta_ger_opti=as.data.frame(cds_ger_opti@colData@listData)

cluster_tab=data.frame(monocle_cluster=c("1","2","3","4","5"),
                       cluster_color=cl_pal)

ggplot(meta_ger_opti, aes(x = UMAP_1_monocle_ger_opti, y = UMAP_2_monocle_ger_opti)) +
```

#####add names and colors to monocle clusters
```{r}
cl_pal <- c("#24ff24", "#D55E00", "#b6dbff", "#0072B2", "#56B4E9")

cluster_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Myogenic transition progenitors",
  "2" = "Advanced myotubes",
  "3" = "MYOD1-high myotubes-1",
  "4" = "Transitional advanced myotubes",
  "5" = "MYOD1-high myotubes-2"
)

cluster_tab_ger_opti <- data.frame(
  monocle_cluster = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
  cluster_color = cl_pal,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_name <- cluster_labels[
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$monocle_cluster
]

cluster_name_pal_ger_opti <- setNames(
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_color,
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_name
)

cluster_id_pal_ger_opti <- setNames(
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_color,
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$monocle_cluster
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Update meta_ger_opti
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

meta_ger_opti$monocle_clusters <- as.character(meta_ger_opti$monocle_clusters)

meta_ger_opti$cluster_name <- cluster_labels[
  meta_ger_opti$monocle_clusters
]

meta_ger_opti$cluster_color <- cluster_id_pal_ger_opti[
  meta_ger_opti$monocle_clusters
]

meta_ger_opti$cluster_name <- factor(
  meta_ger_opti$cluster_name,
  levels = cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_name
)

meta_ger_opti$monocle_clusters <- factor(
  meta_ger_opti$monocle_clusters,
  levels = cluster_tab_ger_opti$monocle_cluster
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Update cds_ger_opti colData with the same annotations
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

colData(cds_ger_opti)$monocle_clusters <- as.character(
  colData(cds_ger_opti)$monocle_clusters
)

colData(cds_ger_opti)$cluster_name <- cluster_labels[
  colData(cds_ger_opti)$monocle_clusters
]

colData(cds_ger_opti)$cluster_color <- cluster_id_pal_ger_opti[
  colData(cds_ger_opti)$monocle_clusters
]

colData(cds_ger_opti)$cluster_name <- factor(
  colData(cds_ger_opti)$cluster_name,
  levels = cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_name
)

colData(cds_ger_opti)$monocle_clusters <- factor(
  colData(cds_ger_opti)$monocle_clusters,
  levels = cluster_tab_ger_opti$monocle_cluster
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rebuild meta_ger_opti from the updated cds
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

meta_ger_opti <- as.data.frame(colData(cds_ger_opti))

# Safety checks
stopifnot(all(!is.na(meta_ger_opti$cluster_name)))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(meta_ger_opti$cluster_color)))

####make the final UMAP

p_umap_ger_opti_names <- ggplot(meta_ger_opti,aes(x = UMAP_1_monocle_ger_opti,y = UMAP_2_monocle_ger_opti)
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cluster_name),size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    title = "Annotated clusters"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "cluster", values = cluster_name_pal_ger_opti, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_classic()

p_umap_ger_opti_names

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(fname_prefix_UMAP, "_", "UMAP_ger_opti_cluster_names.pdf"),
  plot = p_umap_ger_opti_names,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)
```

```{r}
gs <- list(

  ribosome_tone = c("RPLP0","RPL3","RPL5","RPL7","RPL11","RPL13A","RPL23A",

  # ===============================

  # Ref: Schiaffino & Reggiani 2011, Physiol Rev 91:1447-1531; Chemello et al. 2025;

  fiber_type_IIa_fast = c("MYH2","TNNI2","TNNT3","MYL1","ATP2A1","ACTN3","TPM2",
                          "PVALB","LDHA","PKM","PFKM","ENO1","PGAM2","ALDOA",
                          "CKM","DMD","CASQ1"),
  # Ref: Murgia et al. 2021; Bloemberg & Quadrilatero 2012, PLoS ONE 7:e35273;
  # Chemello 2025 -- confirmed, no changes.
  fiber_type_IIx_fast = c("MYH1","ACTN3","MYLK2","TNNT3","TNNI2","ATP2A1","TPM2",
                          "CKM","LDHA","ENO1","PFKM","MYH4"),
  # Ref: Murgia et al. 2021; Uhlén et al., Science 2015 (Human Protein Atlas)
  # [corrected: the foundational HPA paper is Uhlén et al., Science 347:1260419 (2015),
  # not "HPA 2021" -- if you specifically used a 2021 HPA data-freeze/update, cite that
  # release directly rather than this year]
developmental_embryonic = c("MYH3", "MYH8", "MYL4", "TNNI1", "TNNT1",
                             "CHRNG", "NEFM", "NES", "CCND2"),
# Solo geni veramente embrionali/fetali
# Rimossi MYOG, MYOD1, MEF2C, DES, CKM, MYMK, MYMX, ACTA1
# Ref: Chal et al. 2015, Nat Biotechnol; Sampath et al. 2018, Skeletal Muscle
# Wal et al. 2023 cell stem cell
# myotube_fusion_active/myotube_differentiation_fusion better than this signature];
# Hicks et al. 2025 [unverified -- could not confirm an exact 2025 title; the closest
# confirmed real work is the Hicks lab's human limb single-cell atlas / Nat Cell Biol
# 2023 PAX7 niche paper -- double check your exact source]
# and immature contractile/NMJ-associated genes.
# Ref: Schiaffino et al. 2015, Skeletal Muscle 5:22 "Developmental myosins: expression
# patterns and functional significance" [confirmed, correct, and a strong topical fit
# for MYH3/MYH8/MYL4]; Chal et al. 2015, Nat Biotechnol;
# Xi et al. 2020, Cell Stem Cell (human skeletal muscle atlas) -- confirmed.
myotube_fusion_active = c("MYOG", "MYMK", "MYMX", "MEF2C", "DNM2",
                           "ACTA1", "CKM", "DES"),
# Geni del processo di fusione attivo — specifica per la transizione cl8→cl9
# Active myoblast-to-myotube fusion / early terminal differentiation program.
# MYMK and MYMX/Myomerger are core fusogens; MYOG/MEF2C drive terminal
# myogenic differentiation; DNM2 supports membrane-remodeling processes.
# Ref: Millay et al. 2013, Nature 499:301-305; Leikina et al. 2018, Dev Cell 46:767-780;
# Chen, You, Wang et al. 2020, Cell Mol Life Sci 77:1551-1569
# [corrected: this myomaker/myomixer-myomerger-minion review is authored by
# Chen/You/Wang et al., not "Luo"];
# Carvajal/Vicente-Garcia 2022/MEF2C refs [unverified -- this is an informal
# placeholder, not a checkable citation; replace with the actual paper you meant].
#
  sarcomere_core = c("TTN","NEB","ACTN2","TCAP","MYBPC1","MYBPC2","MYL1","MYL2",
                     "TNNI1","TNNI2","TNNT1","TNNT3","TPM1","TPM2","MYOM1","MYOM2","CSRP3","ANKRD1", "FHL1", "MYBPH"),
# Sarcomere/myofibril structural program, extended to include nascent
# sarcomere-associated mechanosensing/remodeling genes enriched in cl9.
# Ref: GO:0030017 sarcomere / GO:0030016 myofibril;
# ANKRD1 MARP/mechanosensing reviews; FHL1 skeletal muscle sarcomere formation
# (Cowling et al. 2008, J Cell Biol 183:1033-1048 -- confirmed, see nascent_myotube_postfusion).
# Lundberg et al. 2019 [unverified -- could not confirm a 2019 myofibril proteomics

# 2. signature per miotubi post-fusione nascenti (cl9)
nascent_myotube_postfusion = c("ANKRD1", "MYBPH", "FHL1", "CDKN1A",
                                "TNNT2", "TNNT3", "BIN1", "COX6A2",
                                "CRYAB", "F13A1", "PTGDS", "SIRT2"),
# Dataset-driven cl9 early post-fusion myotube signature.
# Captures nascent sarcomere/mechanosensing (ANKRD1, FHL1, MYBPH),
# early contractile remodeling (TNNT2/TNNT3), membrane/T-tubule maturation
# (BIN1), cell-cycle exit (CDKN1A), and early metabolic/stress adaptation
# (COX6A2, CRYAB, SIRT2).
# F13A1/PTGDS are retained as top cl9 DEG markers from this dataset and
# should be interpreted as empirical cl9 markers rather than canonical myotube genes.
# Ref: ANKRD1 reviews; Cowling et al. 2008, J Cell Biol 183:1033-1048 (FHL1)
# -- confirmed, correct; BIN1 sarcomere/T-tubule papers;
# Halevy et al. 1995, Science 267:1018-1021 (p21/MyoD terminal differentiation)
# -- confirmed, correct.

                                     "CAMK2A","CAMK2B","CAV3"),

  oxidative_mitochondrial = c("SDHA","SDHB","UQCRC1","NDUFA9","NDUFS1","COX4I1",

                              "PPARGC1A","TFAM","CS","ACADM","NDUFB8","CYCS","PDHA1"),
  # Ref: Lin et al. 2002, Nature 418:797-801; Chemello et al. 2025; Murgia et al. 2021

  glycolytic_fast = c("HK2","PFKM","ALDOA","TPI1","GAPDH","PGK1","PGAM2","ENO1",
                      "PKM","LDHA","PDK1","SLC2A4","PFKFB3","ENO3","MYL1"),
  # Ref: Schiaffino & Reggiani 2011; Chemello 2025 -- confirmed, no changes.
  # ===============================
  # STEM / MYOGENIC LINEAGES
  # ===============================
satellite_cell_core = c("PAX7","VCAM1","ITGA7","CXCR4","MYF5","CDH15","SDC4",
                          "EGFR","NCAM1","SPRY1","MUSTN1","NOS1"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020, Skeletal Muscle (GEO: GSE143704); Yin et al. 2013, Physiol Rev
  # [corrected: GSE143437 is a mouse skeletal-muscle regeneration dataset, not a human
  # atlas -- it does not match De Micheli/Yin here. De Micheli et al. 2020's own data
  # is deposited under GSE143704]
  satellite_cell_core_hiPSC = c("ITGA7","MYF5","CDH15","NCAM1","SPRY1"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020, Skeletal Muscle (GEO: GSE143704); Yin et al. 2013, Physiol Rev

  myoblast_proliferation_cycle = c("MYOD1","MYF5","MKI67","TOP2A","PCNA","CCNB1",
                                   "CDK1","E2F1","NUSAP1","HMGB2","UBE2C","AURKB","RRM2"),
  # Ref: Hicks et al. 2025 [unverified, see note under developmental_embryonic];
  # Trapnell et al. 2014 pseudotime 
  myotube_differentiation_fusion = c("MYOG","MEF2C","MYMK","MYMX","MYH3","MYH8",
                                     "CKM","DES","DNM2","ACTA1"), #similar to the previous (consider that)
  # Ref: Chal et al. 2015, Nat Biotechnol; Sampath et al. 2018, Skeletal Muscle
  # ("Myoblast fusion confusion: the resolution begins" 
  # Hicks 2025 [unverified, see note above]
  myogenic_regulators_axis = c("PAX3","PAX7","MYF5","MYOD1","MYOG","MEF2C","MYF6"),
  # Ref: Weintraub et al. 1991, Science 251:761-766; Rudnicki et al. 1993, Cell 75:1351-1359
  # ===============================
  # NMJ / ECM / NICHE
  # ===============================
  neuromuscular_junction = c("AGRN","LRP4","MUSK","DOK7","RAPSN","COLQ","CHRNA1",
                             "CHRNB1","CHRND","CHRNE","CHRNG","ACHE","UTRN"),
  # Ref: Burden et al. 2018 (hiPSC NMJ) 
  muscle_ecm_basement = c("LAMA2","LAMC1","COL6A1","COL6A2","COL6A3","COL1A1",
                          "COL1A2","COL3A1","FN1","SPP1","LUM","DCN","DAG1",
                          "ITGA7","THY1","COL4A1","COL4A2","COL5A1"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020, Skeletal Muscle; Saini et al. 2021 
  fibro_adipogenic_progenitors = c("PDGFRA","COL1A1","COL3A1","DCN","LUM","CXCL14",
                                   "THY1","GPC6","FBN1","DPT","POSTN","PCOLCE"),
  # Ref: De Micheli et al. 2020, Skeletal Muscle; Front Cell Dev Biol 2025
  # 2022 and 2024 FAP reviews in Front Cell Dev Biol
  atrophy_stress = c("FBXO32","TRIM63","DDIT4","GADD45A","ATF4","FOXO3","PSMA1",
                     "PSMB1","SESN1","SESN3","EIF4EBP1","PPP1R15A"),
  # Ref: Bodine et al. 2001, Science 294:1704-1708; Gomes et al. 2001, PNAS 98:14440-14445
  # Milan et al. 2021
  # ===============================
  # PLURIPOTENCY → MYOGENIC (hiPSC/hESC)
  # ===============================
  pluripotency_core = c("POU5F1","NANOG","SOX2","PRDM14","DPPA2","DPPA4","ZFP42",
                        "DNMT3A","DNMT3B"),
  # Ref: Theunissen et al. 2016, Cell Stem Cell 19:502-515; Nichols & Smith 2009,
  # Cell Stem Cell 4:487-492
  # Ref.Nichols & Smith "Naive and Primed Pluripotent States" is 2009, not 2012
  naive_pluripotency = c("KLF17","KLF4","TFCP2L1","DNMT3L","DPPA3","TBX3","ESRRB","SUSD2"),
  # Ref: Collier et al. 2022 (Maintenance of Human Naive Pluripotent Stem Cells);
  # Pastor et al. 2016, Cell Stem Cell 18:323-329
  # Ref: "Naive human pluripotent cells feature a methylation landscape devoid
  # of blastocyst or germline memory" is 2016, not 2018
  mesoderm_specification = c("MESP1","PDGFRA","KDR","ISL1","HAND1","HAND2","GATA4",
                             "TBX5","NKX2-5","MEF2C","FGF8","EOMES","TBXT"),
  # Ref: Chan et al. 2013, Cell Stem Cell 12:587-601 ("Mesp1 patterns mesoderm into
  # cardiac, hematopoietic, or skeletal myogenic progenitors" -- confirmed, strong fit);
  # Loh et al. 2016, Cell 166:451-467 -- confirmed;
  # Hicks 2025 [unverified, see note under developmental_embryonic]
  early_myogenic_commitment = c("PAX3","PAX7","MYF5","MYOD1","MET","ITGA7","FGFR4","LBX1","MYOG"),
  # Ref: Chal et al. 2015, Nat Biotechnol -- confirmed; Hicks et al. 2025

hiPSC_to_mesoderm_transition= c("TBXT", "MESP1", "MIXL1", "GSC", "EOMES"),
# No Ref given in the original -- not evaluated (nothing to correct).
oxidative_stress_antioxidant=c("NQO1", "HMOX1", "TXNIP", "FTH1", "MT1E", "MT2A", "SLC7A11", "SRXN1")
# No Ref given in the original -- not evaluated (nothing to correct).
)
```

####add new NOVO signatures
#Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404
# ===============================
# NOVO SIGNATURES
# Derived from: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404 — bioengineered human 3D muscle
# tissue (fibrin hydrogel bundles), matured to day 21-35, profiled for
# structural/metabolic maturation, contraction training, B2AR pharmacology,
# insulin/GLUT4 responsiveness, and GYS1-dependent glycogen metabolism.
# The four Fig 2A fiber-type/structural panels were directly verified against
# a user-provided screenshot of Fig 2A (bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404) and of
# Fig 7/S7 from ref [33] (van der Wal et al. 2023, Stem Cell Reports
# 18:1954-1971). Ref 33's Fig 7D heatmap is a ~37-gene combined panel
# (ACTA1, ACTN2, ATP1A2, ATP2A1, CASQ2, CKM, DES, DMD, MYBPC1/2, MYH2/3/6/7/8,
# MYLPF, MYL1/2/3/6/6B, NEB, OBSCN, RYR1, TMOD1, TNNC1/2, TNNI1/2, TNNT1/2/3,
# TPM1/2/3/4, TTN, VIM) that the bioRxiv authors evidently re-split into the
# 4 categories below
# ===============================

```{r}

gs_NOVO <- list(

  # ---- Fig 2A: heatmap of slow-twitch / fast-twitch / fiber-type-independent
  # structural / "not expressed in mature skeletal muscle" gene panels.
  # Verified directly against the Fig 2A screenshot (bioRxiv
  # 2026.01.16.698404) -- all 4 lists match the figure gene-for-gene, with
  # one correction noted below.
  slow_twitch_myofiber_NOVO = c("TNNT1","MYL3","TPM3","MYBPC1","ATP2A2","TPM2","MYL6B",
                                 "MYH7","TNNI1","TNNC1","MYL2"),
  # [corrected: added TPM3, which is present in the Fig 2A slow-twitch panel
  # but was missing from the original draft -- now matches the figure
  # exactly, 11/11 genes]. Overlaps substantially with existing fiber_type_I_slow.

  fast_twitch_myofiber_NOVO = c("TPM1","MYBPC2","ATP2A1","MYH2","MYL1","TNNI2",
                                 "TNNC2","TNNT3","MYLPF","ACTN3"),
  # Matches Fig 2A fast-twitch panel exactly, 10/10 genes.
  # [corrected typo: ATPA2A1 -> ATP2A1]. Overlaps substantially with
  # existing fiber_type_IIa_fast.

  skeletal_muscle_fiber_type_independent_NOVO = c("TPM4","VIM","DES","OBSCN","ACTN2",
                                                    "RYR1","DMD","TMOD1","ACTA1","CKM",
                                                    "NEB","TTN"),
  # Matches Fig 2A "Skeletal muscle" panel exactly, 12/12 genes. [renamed from
  # "scheletal_muscle_NOVO": fixed spelling, matched to the paper's actual
  # category label]. Partial overlap with existing sarcomere_core.

  genes_not_in_mature_skeletal_muscle_NOVO = c("MYH8","MYH6","MYH3","MYL6","MYL4",
                                                 "TNNT2","MYOG"),
  # Matches Fig 2A "Non skeletal muscle" panel exactly, 7/7 genes. MYH8/MYH3
  # also independently confirmed in ref 33's own text (embryonic MYH3/
  # neonatal MYH8 decline with maturation). [renamed from
  # "non_scheletal_muscle_NOVO": fixed spelling, matched to the paper's
  # actual category label]. Conceptually overlaps existing developmental_embryonic.

  glycogen_metabolism_NOVO = c("GYS1","PYGM","PHKA1","PHKB","PHKG1","GBE1",
                                "PPP1R3A","PPP1R3C","GYG1","PGM1","UGP2","STBD1"),
  # GYS1 = glycogen synthase (Fig 7 knockdown: endurance/recovery under
  # glucose starvation); PYGM/PHKA1/B/G1 = glycogen phosphorylase &
  # phosphorylase kinase (Fig 2F, explicitly quantified). GBE1/PPP1R3A/C/
  # GYG1/PGM1/UGP2/STBD1 added as canonical glycogen synthesis/breakdown
  # pathway members (not individually assayed in the paper).
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 2F, Fig 7.

  ampk_energy_sensing_NOVO = c("PRKAA1","PRKAA2","PRKAB1","PRKAB2","PRKAG1",
                                "PRKAG3","STK11","CAB39","CAB39L"),
  # Muscle-dominant AMPK alpha2/beta2/gamma1/gamma3 subunits, upregulated
  # with maturation (Fig 2G, western blot). STK11/CAB39/CAB39L = canonical
  # upstream LKB1 kinase complex, added for pathway completeness.
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 2G.

  beta2_adrenergic_response_NOVO = c("ADRB2","PPARGC1A","NR4A1","NR4A2","NR4A3",
                                      "PGK1","CREB1","LIPE","RPS6","GYS1"),
  # Acute clenbuterol (B2AR agonist) phospho-targets (LIPE=pHSL, CREB1=pCREB,
  # RPS6=pRPS6) and chronic B2AR-responsive transcripts (PPARGC1A, NR4A1/3,
  # PGK1, GYS1) exactly as reported. NR4A2 added as a paralog for completeness.
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 5A-B.

  insulin_glut4_signaling_NOVO = c("SLC2A4","SLC2A1","SLC2A3","INSR","IRS1",
                                    "IRS2","PIK3R1","AKT2","TBC1D4","RAB10"),
  # SLC2A4/1/3 (GLUT4/1/3) shift explicitly measured (Fig 6, Fig S3),
  # reflecting maturation of insulin responsiveness. INSR/IRS1/2/PIK3R1/
  # AKT2/TBC1D4/RAB10 = canonical insulin -> GLUT4 translocation cascade,
  # added for pathway completeness (not individually assayed).
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 6, Fig S3.

  exercise_training_adaptation_NOVO = c("SLC2A4","HK2","PDHA1","PPARGC1A",
                                         "NR4A3","VEGFA"),
  # SLC2A4 (GLUT4), HK2 (HKII), PDHA1 (PDH-E1a) explicitly increased with
  # 12-day contraction training (Fig 4C, protein level). PPARGC1A/NR4A3/
  # VEGFA = canonical endurance-training response genes, added for context.
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 4A-C.

  hypoxia_glucose_fatigue_stress_NOVO = c("HIF1A","SLC16A1","SLC16A3","PDK1",
                                           "LDHA","PFKFB3","VEGFA","CA9","BNIP3"),
  # Functional phenotype (accelerated fatigue + lactate accumulation under
  # hypoxia/glucose starvation) is reported (Fig 3E,3H) but no transcriptomic
  # panel was profiled for this specific experiment — genes here are the
  # canonical HIF1A hypoxia-response/lactate-shuttle module, inferred rather
  # than directly measured. Treat as a mechanistic hypothesis signature.
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 3E, Fig 3H (phenotype only).

  tissue_maturation_3D_vs_monolayer_NOVO = c("MYBPC1","MYL1","MYH2","SDHA","DMD")
  # MYBPC1/MYL1/MYH2 = sarcomeric/contractile genes explicitly induced in
  # day-21 3D bioengineered tissue vs 7-day 2D monolayer myotubes (Fig 1D
  # volcano plot). SDHA = exemplar of the "progressive mitochondrial
  # maturation" DEG cluster (cluster 2); DMD = exemplar of the "early
  # structural consolidation" DEG cluster (cluster 4) (Fig 1F-G).
  # Ref: bioRxiv 2026.01.16.698404, Fig 1D, Fig 1G.
)
 
# To merge into your existing gs list:
gs <- c(gs, gs_NOVO)
```

###add features
```{r}
fix_features <- function(object, genes) {
  present <- intersect(genes, rownames(object))
  if (length(present) == 0L) warning("No genes found from set: ", paste(head(genes, 5), collapse=", "))
  present
}

# Compute module scores for every set in `gs`
for (nm in names(gs)) {
  feats <- fix_features(seurat_ger_opti_AB015, gs[[nm]])
  # skip empty sets
  if (length(feats) == 0L) next
  seurat_ger_opti_AB015 <- AddModuleScore(
    object   = seurat_ger_opti_AB015,
    features = list(feats),        # one set at a time
    nbin = 20,                    # default is 24; adjust if needed
    name     = paste0(nm, "_score")# Seurat will append "1"
  )
  # Move the created column <name>1 into a clean column <name>
  raw_col <- paste0(nm, "_score1")
  if (raw_col %in% colnames(seurat_ger_opti_AB015@meta.data)) {
    seurat_ger_opti_AB015@meta.data[[nm]] <- seurat_ger_opti_AB015@meta.data[[raw_col]]
    # optional: drop the generated column
    seurat_ger_opti_AB015@meta.data[[raw_col]] <- NULL
  }
}

common_cells <- intersect(colnames(seurat_ger_opti_AB015), colnames(cds_ger_opti))
if (length(common_cells) == 0L) stop("No overlapping cells between Seurat and cds.")

for (nm in names(gs)) {
  if (nm %in% colnames(seurat_ger_opti_AB015@meta.data)) {
    vec <- seurat_ger_opti_AB015@meta.data[common_cells, nm, drop=TRUE]
    colData(cds_ger_opti)[common_cells, nm] <- vec
  }
}

feat_to_plot <- c(names(gs))

for (feat in feat_to_plot) {
  if (!feat %in% colnames(colData(cds_ger_opti))) next
  p <- plot_cells(
    cds_ger_opti,
    reduction_method   = "UMAP",
    color_cells_by     = feat,
    label_cell_groups  = TRUE,
    show_trajectory_graph = FALSE
  ) +
    labs(title = feat, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_c(option = "E")
  ggsave(paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_UMAP_sign_", feat, ".pdf"), p, width = 4, height = 3)
}

meta_ger_opti=as.data.frame(cds_ger_opti@colData@listData)

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R, "_monocle_cds_clustered_ger_opti.RData")
save(cds_ger_opti,meta_ger_opti,
     file = Rdata_filename)

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R, "_seurat_clustered_ger_opti.RData")
save(seurat_ger_opti_AB015,meta_ger_opti,
     file = Rdata_filename)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::slice(match(cluster_order_ids, monocle_cluster)) %>%
  { setNames(.$cluster_color, .$monocle_cluster) }

#violin_fill_pal  <- setNames(cluster_tab$cluster_color, cluster_tab$monocle_cluster)

# ── plot loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (module in names(score_labels)) {

  if (!module %in% colnames(meta)) next
  message("Plotting: ", module)

  med_long <- sample_medians %>%
    dplyr::select(monocle_clusters, sample, value = all_of(module))

  p <- ggplot(meta_ger_opti, aes(x = monocle_clusters, y = .data[[module]])) +

    # violin: fill = cluster colour, white interior, coloured outline
    geom_violin(
      aes(fill = monocle_clusters, color = monocle_clusters),
      alpha     = 0.25,       # light fill so dots remain visible
      trim      = FALSE,
      scale     = "width",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # coloured dots = per-sample median
    geom_point(
      data  = med_long,
      aes(x = monocle_clusters, y = value, color = sample),
      size     = 3,
      shape    = 16,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, seed = 42)
    ) +

    # violin fill = cluster colours (light, alpha already set above)
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = violin_fill_pal,
      guide  = "none"          # don't show fill in legend
    ) +

    # colour scale shared by violin outline AND sample dots
    # we need two separate scales: one for violin outline, one for dots
    # easiest: use fill for violin, colour for dots only
    scale_color_manual(
      values = samp_pal,
      name   = "Condition",
      breaks = names(samp_pal)   # only show sample colours in legend
    ) +
scale_x_discrete(
  labels = cluster_labels_ordered,
  limits = cluster_order_ids
)
    #scale_x_discrete(labels = cluster_labels) +

    labs(
      x     = "",
      y     = "AddModuleScore",
      title = score_labels[[module]]
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line          = element_line(color = "#111111"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(color = "#111111"),
      axis.text          = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.title.y       = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      plot.title         = element_text(color = "#111111", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.text        = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      legend.title       = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      legend.key         = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_violin, "_violin_", module, ".pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 6,
    height   = 6
  )
}
```

#####calculate % cells per GER/OPTI cluster

```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sample and cluster order
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_order_ger_opti <- c(
  "OPTIOXd4",
  "GERALTd4",
  "OPTIOXd7",
  "GERALTd7"
)

cluster_order_names_ger_opti <- c(
  "Myogenic transition progenitors",
  "MYOD1-high myotubes-1",
  "MYOD1-high myotubes-2",
  "Advanced myotubes",
  "Transitional advanced myotubes"
)

cluster_order_ids_ger_opti <- names(cluster_labels)[
  match(cluster_order_names_ger_opti, cluster_labels)
]

if (any(is.na(cluster_order_ids_ger_opti))) {
  stop(
    "Some cluster_order_names_ger_opti were not found in cluster_labels: ",
    paste(cluster_order_names_ger_opti[is.na(cluster_order_ids_ger_opti)], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cluster_name_pal_ger_opti <- setNames(
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_color,
  cluster_tab_ger_opti$cluster_name
)

cluster_name_pal_ger_opti <- cluster_name_pal_ger_opti[
  cluster_order_names_ger_opti
]

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate percentage of cells per cluster per sample
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

meta_to_use <- meta_ger_opti %>%
  filter(sample %in% sample_order_ger_opti) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order_ger_opti),
    monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle_clusters),
    cluster_name = as.character(cluster_name)
  )

tot <- table(meta_to_use$sample)

df <- table(meta_to_use$monocle_clusters, meta_to_use$sample)
df <- as.data.frame(df)
colnames(df) <- c("monocle_cluster", "sample", "freq")

total <- as.data.frame(tot)
colnames(total) <- c("sample", "tot")

percent_cl_ger_opti <- df %>%
  left_join(total, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    tot = as.numeric(tot),
    frxn = 100 * freq / tot
  ) %>%
  filter(freq != 0) %>%
  left_join(cluster_tab_ger_opti, by = "monocle_cluster") %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order_ger_opti),
    monocle_cluster = factor(monocle_cluster, levels = cluster_order_ids_ger_opti),
    cluster_name = factor(cluster_name, levels = cluster_order_names_ger_opti)
  )

# Safety checks
stopifnot(all(!is.na(percent_cl_ger_opti$cluster_name)))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(percent_cl_ger_opti$cluster_color)))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Barplot
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_percent_ger_opti <- ggplot(
  percent_cl_ger_opti,
  aes(
    x = sample,
    y = frxn,
    fill = cluster_name
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cluster_name_pal_ger_opti,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "% cells per sample",
    fill = "cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

#####fisher exact test for GER/OPTI subsampled clusters

```{r}

pairwise_cluster_fisher <- function(meta,
                                    cluster_col = "monocle_clusters",
                                    sample_col = "sample",
                                    pairs = list(
                                      c("OPTIOXd4", "GERALTd4"),
                                      c("OPTIOXd7", "GERALTd7"),
                                      c("OPTIOXd4", "OPTIOXd7"),
                                      c("GERALTd4", "GERALTd7")
                                    )) {
  
  clusters <- sort(unique(as.character(meta[[cluster_col]])))
  
  res <- map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    s1 <- pair[1]
    s2 <- pair[2]
    
    meta_sub <- meta %>%
      filter(.data[[sample_col]] %in% c(s1, s2)) %>%
      mutate(
        cluster_chr = as.character(.data[[cluster_col]]),
        sample_chr = as.character(.data[[sample_col]])
      )
    
    n1_total <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s1)
    n2_total <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s2)
    
    map_dfr(clusters, function(cl) {
      n1_in <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s1 & meta_sub$cluster_chr == cl)
      n2_in <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s2 & meta_sub$cluster_chr == cl)
      
      n1_out <- n1_total - n1_in
      n2_out <- n2_total - n2_in
      
      mat <- matrix(
        c(
          n1_in, n1_out,
          n2_in, n2_out
        ),
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = FALSE,
        dimnames = list(
          c("in_cluster", "out_cluster"),
          c(s1, s2)
        )
      )
      
      ft <- fisher.test(mat)
      
      tibble(
        comparison = paste0(s1, "_vs_", s2),
        sample_1 = s1,
        sample_2 = s2,
        monocle_cluster = cl,
        count_1 = n1_in,
        total_1 = n1_total,
        frac_1 = 100 * n1_in / n1_total,
        count_2 = n2_in,
        total_2 = n2_total,
        frac_2 = 100 * n2_in / n2_total,
        diff_frac = (100 * n1_in / n1_total) - (100 * n2_in / n2_total),
        odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
        conf_low = ft$conf.int[1],
        conf_high = ft$conf.int[2],
        p_value = ft$p.value
      )
    })
  }) %>%
    group_by(comparison) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  res
}

meta_fisher_ger_opti <- meta_ger_opti %>%
  filter(sample %in% sample_order_ger_opti) %>%
  mutate(
    monocle_clusters = as.character(monocle_clusters),
    sample = as.character(sample)
  )

stat_pairs_ger_opti <- pairwise_cluster_fisher(
  meta = meta_fisher_ger_opti,
  cluster_col = "monocle_clusters",
  sample_col = "sample"
)

stat_pairs_ger_opti <- stat_pairs_ger_opti %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = factor(
      comparison,
      levels = c(
        "OPTIOXd4_vs_GERALTd4",
        "OPTIOXd7_vs_GERALTd7",
        "OPTIOXd4_vs_OPTIOXd7",
        "GERALTd4_vs_GERALTd7"
      )
    ),
    significant = p_adj_BH <= 0.01,
    low_count_flag = (count_1 + count_2) < 20,
    prop_1 = count_1 / total_1,
    prop_2 = count_2 / total_2,
    log2_prop_ratio = log2((prop_1 + 1e-6) / (prop_2 + 1e-6)),
    neglog10_padj = -log10(p_adj_BH + 1e-300)
  ) %>%
  left_join(cluster_tab_ger_opti, by = "monocle_cluster") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_name = factor(cluster_name, levels = cluster_order_names_ger_opti),
    plot_color = ifelse(significant & !low_count_flag, cluster_color, "grey75"),
    label_me = significant & !low_count_flag
  )

write.csv(
  stat_pairs_ger_opti,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_pairwise_cluster_fisher_ger_opti_subsampled.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
DEG_D4 <- FindMarkers(
  object = seurat_ger_opti_AB015,
  ident.1 = "GERALTd4",
  ident.2 = "OPTIOXd4",
  assay = "originalexp",
  slot = "data",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.01,
  features = rownames(seurat_ger_opti_AB015)
)


DEG_D4 <- DEG_D4 %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("geneID") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    geneID,
    q_value_D4 = p_val_adj,
    logFC_D4 = avg_log2FC
  )

write.csv(DEG_D4, file= paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_", "DEG_D4.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

#Set the significance level cutoff
sig_level <- 0.01
#Set a fold-change cutoff
fc_level <- log2(2)
fc_level2 <- (log2(2))*-1
###################################
N=20


DEG_D4 <- DEG_D4 %>%
  mutate(
    regulation = case_when(
      q_value_D4 < sig_level & logFC_D4 >= fc_level  ~ "up",
      q_value_D4 < sig_level & logFC_D4 <= fc_level2 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    significant = regulation != "other",

    # Protect against adjusted p-values equal to zero
    log10_q_value = -log10(
      pmax(q_value_D4, .Machine$double.xmin)
    )
  )
```

###heatmap D4

```{r}

D4_program_categories <- list(
  "GERALT D4: muscle program" = muscle_genes,
  "OPTi-OX D4: neuronal-like program" = neuronal_genes
)

D4_gene_table_heatmap <- utils::stack(D4_program_categories) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    geneID = as.character(values),
    signature = factor(as.character(ind), levels = names(D4_program_categories))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Generalized version of n3's make_NOVO_heatmap_cds -- takes any gene_table
# with geneID/signature columns instead of hardcoding gs_NOVO
make_program_heatmap_cds <- function(
    cds,
    gene_table,
    group_values,
    groups_to_keep,
    group_labels = groups_to_keep,
    heatmap_title,
    palette_option = "cividis"
) {

  expression_matrix <- monocle3::normalized_counts(cds)

  common_cells <- intersect(colnames(expression_matrix), names(group_values))
  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[, common_cells, drop = FALSE]
  group_values <- as.character(group_values[common_cells])

  cells_to_keep <- !is.na(group_values) & group_values %in% groups_to_keep
  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[, cells_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
  group_values <- factor(group_values[cells_to_keep], levels = groups_to_keep)

  missing_groups <- setdiff(groups_to_keep, unique(as.character(group_values)))
  if (length(missing_groups) > 0) {
    stop("These groups are absent from cds: ", paste(missing_groups, collapse = ", "))
  }

  requested_genes <- unique(gene_table$geneID)
  genes_available <- intersect(requested_genes, rownames(expression_matrix))
  genes_missing <- setdiff(requested_genes, genes_available)
  if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
    message(length(genes_missing), " genes are absent from cds: ",
            paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (length(genes_available) == 0) stop("None of the requested genes is present in cds.")

  expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[genes_available, , drop = FALSE]

  # Average normalized expression within each group (pseudobulk mean)
  group_design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + group_values)
  average_expression <- expression_matrix %*% group_design
  average_expression <- sweep(
    average_expression, MARGIN = 2,
    STATS = Matrix::colSums(group_design), FUN = "/"
  )
  average_expression <- as.matrix(average_expression)
  colnames(average_expression) <- groups_to_keep
  colnames(average_expression) <- group_labels

  # Gene-wise z-score ACROSS GROUPS (not across cells)
  heatmap_zscore <- t(scale(t(average_expression)))
  heatmap_zscore[!is.finite(heatmap_zscore)] <- 0

  heatmap_rows <- gene_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(geneID %in% rownames(heatmap_zscore)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(signature, geneID)

  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_zscore[heatmap_rows$geneID, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- make.unique(heatmap_rows$geneID)

  colour_limit <- max(1, abs(heatmap_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)

  heatmap_colours <- circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, length.out = 101),
    viridisLite::cividis(101)
  )

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    name = "Gene\nz-score",
    col = heatmap_colours,

    row_split = heatmap_rows$signature,
    row_title_rot = 0,
    row_gap = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"),

    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,

    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_labels = heatmap_rows$geneID,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),

    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),

    column_title = heatmap_title,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),

    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Relative\nexpression",
      at = c(-colour_limit, 0, colour_limit),
      labels = c("Lower", "Mean", "Higher")
    ),

    border = TRUE
  )
}

sample_values_D4 <- setNames(
  as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)$sample),
  colnames(cds)
)

D4_heatmap_pseudobulk <- make_program_heatmap_cds(
  cds = cds,
  gene_table = D4_gene_table_heatmap,
  group_values = sample_values_D4,
  groups_to_keep = c("GERALTd4", "OPTIOXd4"),
  group_labels = c("GERALT D4", "OPTi-OX D4"),
  heatmap_title = "D4 muscle and neuronal-like transcriptional programs",
  palette_option = "cividis"
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(D4_heatmap_pseudobulk, heatmap_legend_side = "right")

pdf(
  paste0(fname_prefix_heatmap, "_D4_pseudobulk_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 8, height = 8
)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(D4_heatmap_pseudobulk, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()
```

##DEG D7 GER vs OPTIOX

```{r}
## DEG D7: GERALT versus OPTi-OX

DefaultAssay(seurat_ger_opti_AB015) <- "originalexp"
Idents(seurat_ger_opti_AB015) <- "sample"

DEG_D7 <- FindMarkers(
  object = seurat_ger_opti_AB015,
  ident.1 = "GERALTd7",
  ident.2 = "OPTIOXd7",
  assay = "originalexp",
  slot = "data",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.01,
  features = rownames(seurat_ger_opti_AB015)
)

DEG_D7 <- DEG_D7 %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("geneID") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    geneID,
    q_value_D7 = p_val_adj,
    logFC_D7 = avg_log2FC
  )

write.csv(
  DEG_D7,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_DEG_D7.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Cutoffs
sig_level <- 0.01
fc_level  <- log2(2)
fc_level2 <- -log2(2)
N <- 20

DEG_D7 <- DEG_D7 %>%
  mutate(
    regulation = case_when(
      q_value_D7 < sig_level & logFC_D7 >= fc_level  ~ "up",
      q_value_D7 < sig_level & logFC_D7 <= fc_level2 ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    significant = regulation != "other",
    log10_q_value = -log10(
      pmax(q_value_D7, .Machine$double.xmin)
    )
  )
```

####volcano plot

```{r}

top_genes_D7 <- DEG_D7 %>%

volcano_D7_top <- ggplot(

) +

  ) +
  labs(

      " and |log2FC| ≥ ", fc_level
    ),
    x = "Average log2 fold change",
```

```{r}
####do the volcano plots

volcano_D7_NOVO_list <- list()

for (signature_name in names(gs_NOVO)) {

  signature_results <- DEG_D7_NOVO %>%
    filter(signature == signature_name)

  genes_to_highlight <- signature_results %>%
    filter(significant)

  volcano_signature <- ggplot(
    DEG_D7,
    aes(x = logFC_D7, y = log10_q_value)
  ) +

    # All genes shown only as background
    geom_point(
      colour = "grey80",
      size = 1.3,
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +

    # Significant genes belonging to this NOVO signature
    geom_point(
      data = genes_to_highlight,
      aes(fill = regulation),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3,
      stroke = 0.7,
      colour = "black"
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
      up    = "#CC79A7",
      down  = "#009E73"
      ),
      labels = c(
        up   = "Higher in GERALT",
        down = "Higher in OPTi-OX"
      ),
      name = NULL,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    geom_text_repel(
      data = genes_to_highlight,
      aes(label = geneID),
      size = 3,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      segment.linewidth = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(sig_level),
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(fc_level2, fc_level),
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "GERALT day 7 versus OPTi-OX day 7",
      subtitle = paste0(
        signature_name,
        ": ",
        nrow(genes_to_highlight),
        " significant genes"
      ),
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value"))
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # Store each plot in a named list
  volcano_D7_NOVO_list[[signature_name]] <- volcano_signature

  # Display it in the R Markdown output
  print(volcano_signature)

  # Make signature name safe for filenames
  safe_signature_name <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+",
    "_",
    signature_name
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      fname_prefix_dotplot,
      "_D7_NOVO_",
      safe_signature_name,
      ".pdf"
    ),
    plot = volcano_signature,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}
```

```{r}
  left_join(

      summarise(

  mutate(
    in_gene_list = !is.na(signatures)
```
